description: Super Mario Odyssey is a 3-D Platformer where Mario sets off across the world with his companion Cappy to save Princess Peach and Cappy's sister Tiara from Bowser's wedding plans.

v1.1.description:
MOD
- Added support for shop items
- Balanced coin prices
- Outfits automatically equip when received
- Made regional coins threshold based (getting all regional shop items requires all regional coins) and prevents softlocks from purchasing the wrong item
- Added gifted outfits (i.e. Captain, King, Invisibility)

SERVER
- Added more gift moons to be held by the server, so the in-game check doesn't become inaccessible
- Server logs when an outfit, sticker, or souvenir is collected

APWORLD
- Fixed softlock in Bowser's Kingdom
- Fixed logic for required moons to reach A Traditional Festival
- Added outfit subarea requirements
- Added logic for post game outfits based on moon requirements
- Added shop item locations
- Fixed moon counting to prevent misplaced items
- Added Options: win condition and shopsanity
- Tweaked item placement rules

## What's Changed
* Add support for shop items by @Kgamer77 in https://github.com/Kgamer77/SuperMarioOdysseyArchipelago/pull/1

## New Contributors
* @Kgamer77 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kgamer77/SuperMarioOdysseyArchipelago/pull/1

v1.5.description:
## Mod
- Fixed Multi-moons crashing when grabbed in a kingdom that hasn't been unlocked yet. Now sends player to last unlocked kingdom
- Slight change to allow regional coins to work while randomization feature is still WIP
- Added DeathLink support
- Fixed already collected multi-moons crashing the game
- Added going to a kingdom that hasn't been unlock syncs scenario depending on what multi-moon locations have been checked
- Fixed Multi-Moon locations not sending

## Server
- Removed

## World
- Removed romfs option
- Added romfs option to host.py for patching (This is similar to other games that require a rom to apply patches to except just the folder directory)
- Changed item names to correspond with in-game names.
- Added Super Mario Odyssey Client that can be opened via Archipelago Launcher
- Client now handles all game connection obsoleting Server.
- Now generates `.apsmo` patch file that can be applied using `Open Patch` in the Archipelago Launcher
- `.apsmo` file only generated when an option requiring patching is enabled.
- SMO Client now stores checks and sends then to the AP lobby after successful login.
- Slight change to allow regional coins to work while randomization feature is still WIP
- `Sync` command added to SMO Client for force syncing inventory with AP lobby.
- Item syncing made more robust
- Fixed shop item checks not working properly due to error in packet structure.
- Added DeathLink support
- Added `/warp` command for debugging and softlock prevention
- Changed how directories are handled to fix issues on Linux #22 
- Fixed most client instability hopefully.
- Fixed patching issues caused by changes in AP 0.6.2
- Fixed crash caused by progress packet being handled improperly

v1.5-beta.description:
## Mod
- Added NPC behavior changes to allow NPCs to give you their moons repeatedly to prevent soft locks and remove the dependency on the server connector that sometimes required starting from a new file after soft locking or soft lock looping infinitely due to these moons not syncing correctly
- Added pipes that connect branching worlds (Lake and Wooded, Seaside and Snow)
- Added pipe connecting Bowser to Luncheon to allow backtracking and prevent soft locks when not having all Bowser story moons to progress

## Server
- Server now handles distributing moon when received from the lobby instead of the lobby passing it by id

## World
- Completely new logic
- Fixed duplicate goal placements when Story/Multi moon randomization is disabled
- Added moon count randomization which randomizes the number of moons needed to upgrade the Odyssey in a kingdom
- Added moon color randomization which randomizes the colors of power moons in all kingdoms except Mushroom.
- Added text patch to patch shop item names to be the name of the AP item at the location.
- Added romFS option to the settings. This is where you put the path to the contents of the mod romfs folder for applying game patches.
- Output generates a zip folder containing the patch data.
- Now supports Archipelago 0.6.1
- Fixed MSBT serializer
- Fixed logic allowing for multiple SMO instances in a single multiworld

# Warning: This is a beta build and has not been tested fully, bugs are likely.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kgamer77/SuperMarioOdysseyArchipelago/compare/v1.4...v1.5-beta

v1.7.0.description:
AP World Changes:
- Built-in Universal Tracker Tab
- Glitch logic in Universal Tracker (still in-development)
- Many logic improvements
  - Cap > Cascade requires Frog. Frogless is no longer required
  - Most of Cascade requires Chain Chomp. First moon skip is no longer required
  - Inverted Pyramid requires Bullet Bill
  - Uproot and Sherm required for much more of Wooded's Story
  - And many other small improvements for individual moons
- Moon requirements for "Same Total" and "Same Total Lock Ruined" are now +/- 5 from the base game, rather than completely random
- Moons are now progression-balanced items
- It is now possible to gen with a Sand Kingdom goal
- Turning shopsanity off completely removes shop items from the item pool
- Disable death link temporarily while in the Cap Kingdom Spark Pylon to prevent a softlock
- Added a `/die` command to simulate receiving a deathlink
- Added a `/deathlink` command to turn deathlink on and off in an existing game. Resets whenever you reconnect to the AP server
- Improved the help message for all commands

Mod Changes:
- Fixed the Cap Kingdom Spark Pylon sometimes not capturing
- Topper will now always appear when spawning in Cap Kingdom Scenario 1
  - No more forced restarts because you received a death link after beating Topper
- Significant Networking improvements
- Colored messages in the Text Client
- Text Client now supports up to 5 messages
- Bound Bowl no longer crashes the game
- Receiving a death link during Bound Bowl now has a special interaction
  - This avoids a crash when dying during bound bowl
- The Wooded Kingdom and Lake Kingdom switch pipes have been slightly adjusted
- Wooded Kingdom purples no longer disappear if you choose Lake first
- Flower Field loading zone never despawns
- Most captures now uncapture when being captured without the corresponding check, rather than being killed entirely


And probably more that I've forgotten by now. The game is far more stable now, and the logic is far more sensible, aiming to ensure that even first-time players can enjoy the Archipelago

Known Issues:
- Receiving a death while buying a shop moon crashes the game
- Capturesanity logic past Wooded needs to be investigated for potential issues
- The code base is messy and needs a refactor
v1.7.0.title: v1.7.0

v1.7.2.description:
#### Only the apworld was changed in this update. You do not need to update your mod installation!

- Fixed an issue that broke genning with Capturesanity enabled
    - This was a regression in v1.7.1. Genning is now confirmed working with Capturesanity enabled and disabled
- Fixed snow's moon total
    - This was an issue introduced in the development phases of v1.7.0 due to bound bowl crashing the game. As bound bowl no longer crashes, the moon total was able to be reset
- Fixed an issue with "Doctor in the House" when the goal was set to Dark Side and moon counts were set to Moderate
    - Doctor in the House requires 240 moons to unlock the relevant outfit, but on some Dark Side seeds, there weren't 240 moons to collect. This moon is now removed if there aren't enough moons for it to be 

Known Issues:
- In very rare cases, darker side goals may fail to generate. This issue might have been resolved, but it's rare enough that it's hard to be certain

Special thanks to @itz_trackz on Discord for helping test for genning issues using the Fuzzer! This helped to track down a couple of smaller generation errors, and also helps ensure that this release and future releases will not regress

v1.7.6.description:
New Features:
- Cascade Kingdom will now skip to the revisit scenario when relevant
- Added a new Common Capture Skips option
  - Includes Frogless, First Moon Skip, Impossible Jump, and Skipping Uproot in the Red Maze
- Added item placement priority for for Moons and Chain Chomp
  - This will encourage moons belonging to early kingdoms to be placed earlier, and moons belonging to late kingdoms to be placed later, hopefully reducing situations where you unlock multiple kingdoms at once
- Frog is now forced to be in Sphere 1

Fixes:
- Extra Moons are now marked as Filler
  - This will help ensure progression balancing can work more effectively
- Post-game Outfit Moons now use the correct number of moons
  - This fixes Dark Side's issue in #2
- Cascade Revisit now requires beating Madame Broode
  - This was an oversight in the previous version by making Madame Broode skippable
- Adjusted the mod's scenario tracking to rely on the game's internal scenario tracking
  - This should help with some situations where the mod would detect the wrong scenario
- Made an attempt to fix some story progression issues
  - This doesn't seem to have made much difference in the limited testing I've done so far, but has been left in for this release
- Added Wooded Kingdom's Red Maze region and Moon Kingdom's Doctor in the House region to the list of all moons
  - This resolves Darker Side's issue in #2
- Fixed the spelling of a few moons
- Fixed go-mode detection for Universal Tracker

Experimental Features:
- Added Progressive Moons
  - This is *only* implemented in the logic, and does not have client or mod support. You *will* experience client errors if you enable it
  - This option should never show up anywhere, and requires being manually added to the yaml to discourage its use
  - This feature ended up requiring a larger rewrite than I anticipated, so it may stay in this state for a while
v1.7.6.title: v1.7.6
